entities.name: Query CoaBC enzyme
observations: 404 aa protein with predicted molecular weight 41.89 kDa and pI 6.42.
Pfam domains: Flavoprotein PF02441.26 at residues 3-174 and DFP PF04127.23 at residues 182-397.
Shares 51.6-52.3% identity over 97.0-98.0% coverage with reviewed mycobacterial CoaBC proteins.
Sequence-based assignment is moderate homology support, not direct experimental characterization of the query.

entities.name: CoaBC
observations: Bifunctional coenzyme A biosynthesis enzyme catalyzing phosphopantothenate--cysteine ligase and phosphopantothenoylcysteine decarboxylase activities.
Reviewed reference proteins A0QWT2, P67734, and P9WNZ0 have EC 6.3.2.5 and EC 4.1.1.36 annotations.
Binds FMN and requires Mg2+ according to reviewed reference annotations.

entities.name: 4-phosphopantothenate cysteine ligation
observations: Rhea RHEA:19397: (R)-4'-phosphopantothenate + L-cysteine + CTP → N-[(R)-4-phosphopantothenoyl]-L-cysteine + CMP + diphosphate + H+.
Corresponds to EC 6.3.2.5 phosphopantothenate--cysteine ligase activity.

entities.name: 4-phosphopantothenoylcysteine decarboxylation
observations: Corresponds to EC 4.1.1.36 phosphopantothenoylcysteine decarboxylase activity.

entities.name: Coenzyme A biosynthesis
observations: CoaBC catalyzes steps 2 and 3 of CoA biosynthesis from (R)-pantothenate: cysteine ligation followed by decarboxylation.
